interface.title: Jee's individual mouse explorer
interface.field: Behavioural neuroscience: home-cage RFID tracking of mice in a 4-pen, 2-floor colony connected by bridges and stairs
interface.stage_of_work: Data cleaning, exploratory analysis and export of per-animal behavioural measures from raw RFID antenna reads
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a colony's RFID antenna CSV exports, pick one tagged mouse, and look at its activity rhythm, space use, movement between zones and pens, and feeding, then export summary tables and figure bundles.

data.note: Used the pre-filled sidebar folder path /work/app/data and pressed 'Load data'. Nothing was uploaded. The app reported 'Loaded 75,746 reads · 11 mice', with raw rows 75,785, unique after de-dup 75,785 and clean reads 75,746 (39 reads dropped as noise). The 16 shipped CSVs in data/ hold exactly 75,785 rows and do not overlap, so the counts are correct for this sample. 'No duplicates removed' reflects the sample data and is not evidence that the de-dup step failed. The README's ~308k raw / ~124k unique figures describe a fuller dataset. Data runs from 2026-07-16 20:09 to 2026-07-20 17:43. The default mouse was M147. Every control change reruns a 'Computing visits & transitions…' step that takes roughly 30–90 s.
